question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Peculiar
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Peculiar"** means something that is unusual or not typical; it can refer to something that is strange or odd. (अजीब)

 
 
• **Example: **She has a **peculiar **habit of humming while she works.
 
 
 
• **"Strange" **refers to something that is unusual or not normal, often implying a sense of mystery or unfamiliarity. (अजीब)
 
 
• **Example: **The house had a **strange**, eerie feeling to it.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Peculiar' **is **'Strange'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Usual** (सामान्य): Something that is commonly occurring or done; typical.

 
 
• **Example:** It is **usual **for him to take a walk in the evening.
 
 
 
• **Frequent** (अक्सर): Happening often or at short intervals.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a **frequent **visitor to the library.
 
 
 
• **Revolutionary** (क्रांतिकारी): Involving or causing a complete or dramatic change.
 
 
• **Example:** The invention of the internet was a **revolutionary** development.
